problem_statement: Build a brand-new Feature Entitlements page at the route /entitlements on the SvelteKit SaaS Kit site. The route does not exist yet (navigating to /entitlements currently 404s). Create the SvelteKit route file src/routes/(marketing)/entitlements/+page.svelte so the page renders inside the site's existing marketing shell (sticky header nav + footer) and reuses the design system (Tailwind design tokens card/border/primary/muted-foreground, the Section landing components, and the Button component). The page presents a feature x plan entitlement matrix: rows are features (Advanced analytics, SSO & SAML, Audit logs, API access, Priority support) and columns are plans (Free, Pro, Enterprise). Every cell is a click-driven toggle button showing On/Off that grants or revokes that feature for that plan, and a live 'N entitlements enabled' summary heading counts how many cells are on across all plans. Add a click-driven column filter (Hide Free column / Show all columns buttons) that hides or shows the Free plan column WITHOUT resetting any toggles: a user who enables a feature for Pro, hides the Free column, then shows all columns again, must still see that Pro cell enabled and the count unchanged. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: Page heading 'Feature Entitlements' (h1) inside the marketing shell
A live summary heading (h2) reading 'N entitlements enabled' that reflects the current number of enabled cells (7 in the seed state)
A feature x plan matrix with five feature rows (Advanced analytics, SSO & SAML, Audit logs, API access, Priority support) each titled by an h3
Three plan columns: Free, Pro, Enterprise
Every matrix cell is a click-driven toggle button (data-toggle="<feature>:<plan>") showing On when the entitlement is granted and Off otherwise
A click-driven column filter with a 'Hide Free column' button and a 'Show all columns' button (NOT a native <select>)
Interaction: clicking a cell flips its On/Off state and updates the live 'N entitlements enabled' count
State-linked persistence: toggled cells survive the column show/hide filter — enabling a cell then hiding the Free column then showing all columns keeps that cell enabled and the count unchanged
Responsive layout: the matrix fits a 390px mobile viewport with zero horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse the marketing layout group (marketing) so the page inherits the site header nav and footer
Reuse Tailwind design tokens: bg-card / text-card-foreground / border-border / border-primary / text-muted-foreground / bg-primary / text-primary-foreground

Use the site's existing light palette so the page matches the reference: page background white (#ffffff, rgb(255,255,255)); primary body text near-black #0a0a0a (rgb(10,10,10)); primary / emphasis surfaces use the near-black token #171717 (rgb(23,23,23)) with light foreground text #fafafa (rgb(250,250,250)) (e.g. an enabled 'On' toggle and the active 'Show all columns' button render dark with light text); muted text and 'Off' toggles use grey #737373 (rgb(115,115,115)); borders use light grey #e5e5e5 (rgb(229,229,229)); default border-radius 6px
Reuse the Section landing components (Section.Root / Section.Header / Section.Description) and the shared Button component

Toggle cells must carry a unique data-toggle="<feature>:<plan>" attribute and the column-filter controls a data-col-filter attribute so they are selectable without relying on shell-chrome text (no native <select>)
Use deterministic in-memory seed data (no network fetch)
